errors.text: The proposed low-shear-strength amorphous layer is said to cause a friction spike, but lower interfacial shear strength would ordinarily reduce friction unless an additional dissipative or adhesion mechanism is demonstrated.

Non-FCC coordination and reduced dislocation line length are treated as evidence of amorphization, although they can also arise from HCP stacking faults, thermally distorted FCC environments, defect escape, or mechanical annealing.
